vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: kg-note-method-obsidian
Version: 2.23.0

The skill bundle is a highly detailed set of instructions for an AI agent to manage and organize an Obsidian vault using a 'Knowledge Graph' (KG) methodology. It defines specific workflows for note categorization (Concept, Thing, Skill, Relation), YAML metadata management, and automated relationship building. While the skill utilizes high-privilege capabilities such as file system access (read/write/patch) and network requests (web search and image embedding via curl), these actions are strictly aligned with the stated purpose of note enrichment and organization. No evidence of malicious intent, data exfiltration, or unauthorized command execution was found in SKILL.md or the supporting reference files.

llm.summary: This instruction-only Obsidian note-organizing skill is coherent and disclosed, but users should expect it to read, search, and persistently modify notes and to use web searches for enrichment.

dimensions.detail: The requested capabilities—reading notes, searching the vault, creating relationship notes, fixing metadata, and enriching notes—match the stated Obsidian KG note-organization purpose, but they can change many local files.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The skill defines broad activation and non-skippable workflow rules for Obsidian note tasks. This is purpose-aligned, but users should be aware it may be applied automatically when an Obsidian path or note-organizing task appears.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: There is no install spec and no code files, so supply-chain execution risk is low. The instructions do reference external commands/tools such as curl, but no automatic installer is present.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Local vault searches, note edits, web searches, and image URL checks are proportionate to the skill’s purpose, but they may expose note topics to search providers and affect the user’s persistent note library.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill has no credentials or elevated privileges, but it intentionally creates, modifies, renames, and sometimes deletes persistent Markdown note content.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears purpose-aligned and instruction-only, with no code or credential requirements. Before installing, understand that normal use is meant to change your Obsidian vault: it may read related notes, create many relationship files, edit YAML, remove direct links, and enrich notes with web-sourced content or image links. Back up the vault first and use `kg 检查` when you want recommendations without file changes.

evidence.explanation: The skill asks to be loaded automatically for broad Obsidian-related contexts. This is consistent with its purpose, but it expands when the agent may apply these rules.
evidence.snippet: 打开任何 Obsidian 笔记前先加载本 skill... 路径含 `D:\App\Obsidian\RealGhost` 或任务涉及笔记整理 → 自动触发本 skill

agenticRiskFindings.recommendation: Install only if you want this KG workflow to govern Obsidian note tasks; use the check-only command when you want analysis before changes.
agenticRiskFindings.userImpact: The agent may apply this note-organization workflow whenever it recognizes the specified Obsidian vault path or a note-organizing task.

evidence.explanation: The workflow directs the agent to read, search, patch, create, and sometimes delete local note files. This is central to the stated organizer purpose, but it is real local file mutation authority.
evidence.snippet: `read_file` 先读... `search_files` 搜库... 用 `patch` 在闭合 `---` 前插入... 不可用 `write_file` 整体覆盖... 新建/修改/删除的文件清单

agenticRiskFindings.recommendation: Back up or version-control the vault before use, review the change list after each run, and prefer `kg 检查` for a non-mutating review first.
agenticRiskFindings.userImpact: A normal run can make persistent changes across the Obsidian vault, including metadata edits, new relationship notes, moved content, removed direct links, and possible deletions.

evidence.explanation: The skill references running a local curl command to check remote image URLs. This is narrow and purpose-aligned, but it is still local command execution and network access.
evidence.snippet: 疑似失效的网络图片 → `curl -I` 检查状态码，404/403 则搜有效替代。

agenticRiskFindings.recommendation: Allow this only if outbound URL checks are acceptable; otherwise ask the agent to skip network image validation.
agenticRiskFindings.userImpact: The agent may make outbound HTTP header requests when validating image links.

evidence.explanation: The skill can add web-derived content and persistent relationship files to the user's note vault, which may later be reused as context.
evidence.snippet: `kg 完善 "笔记名.md"`... 搜索网络补充更新 → 标注信息来源... 新建关系笔记（`A - 关系 - B.md`）

agenticRiskFindings.recommendation: Review sourced additions, especially for important notes, and ask the agent to cite sources clearly before accepting changes.
agenticRiskFindings.userImpact: Incorrect or untrusted web results could become part of the persistent knowledge base and influence later note organization or agent answers.

evidence.explanation: The workflow encourages broad propagation of relationship creation across related notes. This is intended behavior, but a mistaken classification or association could create many persistent changes.
evidence.snippet: 搜到的每个有效关联必须在步骤⑤建关系，不可跳过... 同一操作轮次必须搜关联→至少建一条关系... 对一批新主体，两两检查是否应有关系线

agenticRiskFindings.recommendation: Use check-only mode for large batches and review proposed relationships before allowing broad updates.
agenticRiskFindings.userImpact: One wrong search result or interpretation could lead to multiple unnecessary relationship notes or edits across the vault.

abnormal_behavior_control.summary: The skill uses broad but disclosed note-editing workflows, automatic activation cues, web checks, and cascading relationship creation that fit the Obsidian KG organizer purpose.

permission_boundary.summary: No credentials, tokens, account access, or elevated privilege requirements are declared or shown.

sensitive_data_protection.summary: The skill can persist web-derived content and relationship context in the note vault, so users should review additions before relying on them.
